comment: States a level asks an object for that ship no art at all. sub_40FDA0 stores the state regardless and keeps the previous clip, so the object reaches its damaged look without a transition; the port settles an unplayable DESTROY_n on its DESTROYED_n instead. The list is generated so a batch of new levels does not have to be transcribed, and --check diffs it both ways, so a state that stops resolving still fails.
